# M2 — Stub Rewrites (65 Tier-3 characters)

**Milestone file:** `1786049707544-m2-stub-rewrites.md`
**Depends on:** M1 (`…-m1-template-and-strategy.md`) — MUST be done first.
**Deliverable:** 65 Tier-3 auto-generated stub `.prompt.md` rewritten to Tier-1.
**Status:** executable. Run as its own chat; read master + M1 docs first.

---

## Goal

Replace every character `.prompt.md` still stamped *"Auto-generated from
character YAML by `scripts/generate-missing-content.mjs`"* with a full,
lore-grounded Tier-1 prompt following the M1 canonical template. These are the
worst-quality files (generic boilerplate, wrong/deprecated `source:` paths, no
Expression Variants) and give the highest per-file lift.

## Scope — detect (run this to enumerate the exact 65)

```bash
cd /home/anthony/code/las_flores_city
grep -rl 'Auto-generated from character YAML' content/characters/ \
  | sed 's|.*/characters/||; s|/.*||' | sort
```

Process **alphabetically**; treat the live grep output as the authoritative
list (do not hard-code a stale list from this doc).

## Per-character steps (static → AI → gate)

1. Read `content/characters/<slug>/<slug>.md` end-to-end (lore first).
2. Read `content/characters/<slug>/char_<slug>.yaml` (name, title, faction, role).
3. Apply the **static-extraction map** (M1 spec): pull the fields; if the `.md`
   has no physical description, assign unique anatomy from the VST contrast axes
   using `character_prompt_audit.json` as the collision reference.
4. Author the TLS-1 file per the **canonical template** (M1 spec), including a
   real `## Negative Prompt` and a full `## Expression Variants` section.
5. Run the **quality gate** (gotchas Pre-Flight Checklist). Fix until it passes.
6. Keep the existing `char_<slug>.yaml` **unchanged** — only the `.prompt.md`
   is rewritten (assets and YAML `portrait_urls` are a later pass).

## Acceptance criteria (M2)

- [ ] `grep -rl 'Auto-generated from character YAML' content/characters/ | wc -l` → **0**
- [ ] Every rewritten file follows the M1 canonical template (has frontmatter,
      `## Prompt (Draft)`, `## Prompt`, `## Negative Prompt`, `## Variations`,
      `## Expression Variants`).
- [ ] No rewritten `source:` points to `docs/lore/figures/`.
- [ ] No character name appears inside Draft/Prompt/Expression Variant prose.
- [ ] `node scripts/content-audit.mjs` passes (no new errors).

## Verification (after each batch; commit per batch)

```bash
grep -rl 'Auto-generated from character YAML' content/characters/ | wc -l
grep -rl 'docs/lore/figures/' content/characters/*/*.prompt.md | wc -l
node scripts/content-audit.mjs
```
